title: Answers of the bot on a multilingual corpus of manuals, scope C: the image descriptions in the chunks

corpus.label: scope C
corpus.description: use and maintenance manuals of a family of machines (Word)
corpus.revisions: up to 4 per document, kept as its git history

sample.how: 30 questions (20 precise, 10 broad) written by Claude Sonnet from the Italian manual of one model and translated into six languages with the sections found in each manual (209: one dropped, its answer is not in that language's manual); 24 on revisions (6 passages changed between the first and the latest revision of a model, in two languages, asked for the first revision and without one); 24 on data that differ between 4 models, asked with the scope of 3 models; 10 in German, a language without manuals; 10 on the whole family, without a model. 4 of the 277 have no answer in the manuals
sample.figures_how: 10 questions in Italian and English written by Claude Opus 5.5 looking at the images of one model: 4 on details that the text leaves to the drawing, 6 on safety pictograms described by sight, whose meaning is in the manual's table of symbols

judge_rules: score from -10 to +10 with a reason; the judge reads the question, the expected answer, the bot's answer and the sources given to the bot (up to 18,000 characters)
"I don't know" scores 0; information taken from the sources is not invented; leaving something out is not an error
good: score of 7 or more; wrong: below 0; the score of an answer is the mean of gemma4 and qwen3

gpu_host.use: every model: embeddings, reranker, answers, judges, image descriptions, OCR models
gpu_host.rule: everything stays in the 16 GB of VRAM, nothing offloaded to the CPU

cpu_host.use: gosidian, the plugins, Qdrant and PostgreSQL, the converters that run on the CPU

software.gosidian: development build released as v2.99.0 (the cut rules media_paragraphs and icon_descriptions)

config: the bot of scope C: a local model (gemma4:12b) reads the language and the revision a question asks for; the search filters the paragraphs by language and by the scope (a model or the family), falling back to Italian and English when the question's language has no manual; paragraphs in Qdrant, Qwen3-Embedding-8B at 2048, ef 128, bge-reranker-v2-m3, k 5, the same text in several manuals given once, the section as context, images in place, gemma4:12b with 12,288 tokens, the answer in the language of the question

variants.label: no image descriptions, 20 candidates
variants.change: the manuals as converted, images as links; 20 candidates

variants.label: descriptions as paragraphs of their own, 20 candidates
variants.change: every image described in the manual's language; an image on a line of its own is a paragraph

variants.label: descriptions as paragraphs of their own, 40 candidates
variants.change: the reranker reads 40 candidates instead of 20

figures.label: descriptions as paragraphs of their own, 40 candidates

times.answers: 277 in 20-23 minutes with the queue full, about 4-5 s each
